title: Make Reviewer Queue Sync Idempotent
specification:
# PRD: Make Reviewer Queue Sync Idempotent

Priority: high

## Problem
Reviewer queue sync rewrites `updatedAt` on every scheduler tick, causing frequent `autonomy(queue): sync reviewer queue` commits that only change timestamps.

## Goal
Stop timestamp-only reviewer queue commits while preserving real queue-state updates and review reconciliation behavior.

## Requirements
- Preserve existing reviewer task `updatedAt` when derived reviewer task content is semantically unchanged.
- Only bump reviewer task `updatedAt` when meaningful task fields change, including status, source task, review round, PR linkage, merge/decision fields, dispatcher fields, or conversation references.
- Ensure `syncTrackedReviewerQueues()` does not commit when the resulting reviewer queue is semantically identical to the tracked queue.
- Keep legitimate reviewer queue commits for assignments, approvals, changes requested, merges, stale-review requeues, and reconciliation from `changes_requested` to `merged`.
- Avoid rewriting existing git history as part of the functional fix.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Running two scheduler sync ticks against unchanged PR/reviewer state creates no second reviewer queue commit.
- A date-only `updatedAt` change is not staged or committed for `prompts/autonomous/v2/queues/reviewer.json`.
- A real reviewer task status transition still updates the queue and commits once.
- Existing review follow-up refresh and stale review reconciliation behavior remains intact.

## Verification
- Add or update unit coverage around `buildDerivedReviewerTask()` or sync flow to assert stable `updatedAt` for unchanged derived tasks.
- Add an integration-style test using a fixture repo that runs sync twice and asserts the reviewer queue commit count is unchanged on the second run.
- Run the relevant unit tests for reviewer follow-up refresh, control-plane status reconciliation, and review queue state.
